RegulatoryData.name: Regulatory Data
RegulatoryData.definition: Information about legal and regulatory data exchanged between invoicing and paying party.

Service.name: Service
Service.definition: Identification of the service or system for which the billing information is provided.

InvoiceDate.name: Invoice Date
InvoiceDate.definition: Date at which the billing report was created.

BillingIdentification.name: Billing Identification
BillingIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the billing report.

BillingPeriod.name: Billing Period
BillingPeriod.definition: Date period for which the report data is valid.

ResponsiblePartyIdentification.name: Responsible Party Identification
ResponsiblePartyIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the party responsible for the referenced party (that is, which has a contractual responsibility for the billed customer).

PartyIdentification.name: Party Identification
PartyIdentification.definition: Unique identification to unambiguously identify the billed party.

AccountInvoiceTotals.name: Account Invoice Totals
AccountInvoiceTotals.definition: Specifies totals related to the invoice per account.

InvoiceTotals.name: Invoice Totals
InvoiceTotals.definition: Specifies totals related to the invoice.

ServiceCategoryTotals.name: Service Category Totals
ServiceCategoryTotals.definition: Specifies totals related to the service category.
